## Notes

Room Controller Levels 1-8 unlock spawns, extensions, towers, storage, links, labs, terminal, factory, observer, and nuker at cumulative upgrade energy; unupgraded controllers downgrade; Global Control Level sets claimable rooms and CPU (10 per level up to 300) and is never lost.
